answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a postage gate priced per identity. Each agent pays a full anchor fee, fixed work or a bond, and every identity counts as having paid in full. Cloning means buying another anchor each time, so the marginal cost of one extra vote never drops; an honest operator amortises one anchor across many tasks while the attacker's cost stays linear. Tying the fee to scarce shale, or to a basalt-signed commitment that cannot be copied, stops precomputation from covering the swarm. A thousand fakes thus burn the capital of a thousand honest entrants.
